entries.speaker: Former Holy Grail
entries.en: I am the administrator born of the[n]collective human unconscious.

entries.speaker: Former Holy Grail
entries.en: The god of control, Yaldabaoth.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: This is crazy! It's like a building!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It was already huge back when it was[n]the Holy Grail...

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: The administrator must guide mankind[n]toward proper development.

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: And now that the foolishness of man has[n]been proven, it is the administrator's duty[n]to purge them.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You kiddin'!? This is just some kinda[n]rigged game you started!

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: The foolish masses merely spread indolent[n]thoughts and force the progress of society[n]backward.

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: If left to humanity, the world[n]would slowly meet its demise.[n]Rehabilitation is impossible now.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That doesn't mean humans are evil[n]though!

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: Indeed. There are many upstanding[n]citizens. However, they merely take[n]the sole path before them.

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: The act of making decisions is[n]accompanied by nothing but pain.

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: Even if a cliff of ruin lay ahead, these[n]lemmings would march onward without[n]a second thought...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Bullshit! You're just forcin' your selfish[n]ideas on people!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: For a god, you're pretty damn prejudiced!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: If this is all for the sake of humanity,[n]wouldn't being beaten by humans[n]satisfy you?

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: I am the entity which governs this world.[n]Its future depends wholly on my[n]leadership.

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: Those who dare defy this natural order[n]shall be met with punishment raining[n]down from the heavens.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Ngh...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Rgh... That thing's on a totally different[n]level!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Can we defeat something like him?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This is the best possible outcome!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We're fighting against a god who's not[n]holding anything back, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What bigger target could there be for[n]the Phantom Thieves to tackle?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Although... it's still way too big for my[n]liking.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: All right, I'll give the navigation[n]everything I've got!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: We can do this if we all work together!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Let's take him down!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Crowning our glory by defeating a god...[n]Now that is true art.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We basically just gotta beat that thing,[n]right!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Man... You guys are the best, stupidest[n]group I could ask for.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm so glad I was able to be a part of[n]your team...
Let's win this.
It's not over yet.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Heh... You're right.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We'll take it all back...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Our future...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: And this world!
